import ffi as c (C!)
import os (..)

C! struct Pair {
    c.int a;
    c.int b;
}

fn free-pair(p: Pair) { c.free(p) }

class Box : IntoPtr[_] { __ptr__() -> Ptr[_] { Ptr[Int](0) } }
fn wants-int(x: IntoPtr[Int]) -> Int { 0 }

fn seek(token) -> Int | nil {
    let size = token.size()
    let buf = Blob()
    buf.push('abc')
    buf.clear(0, 1)
    buf.search(token) ?? size
}

fn count(token) -> Int {
    let n = #token
    Blob().search(token) ?? n
}

fn decode(query: String) -> Dict[String, String | Array[String | nil] | nil] {
    let params = %{}
    for [k, ?v] in query.split('&').map(p -> p.split('=', 1)) {
        match params[k] {
            nil         => { params[k] = v        },
            one: String => { params[k] = [one, v] },
            many        => { many.push(v)         }
        }
    }
    params
}

fn commit-later() -> Int {
    let data = nil
    fn commit(x: Int) {
        if data != nil {
            data.push(x)
        }
    }
    fn part() { data = [] }
    part()
    commit(1)
    #(data ?? [])
}

use Handler = {req: Int, rsp: String, params: *_, kwargs: **_} -> Int;
fn dispatch(f: Handler, ps: Dict[String, String]) -> Int { f(1, 'a', **ps) }
fn handler(req: Int, rsp: String, id: String = '') -> Int { #id }

fn route-map() -> Int {
    let routes: Dict[String, Array[String]] = %{*: []}
    let handlers = routes['GET'] ?? []
    handlers.push('/x')
    handlers.sort!(by=\-(#_))
    routes['GET'] = handlers
    #handlers
}

fn member(headers: Dict[String, String | Array[String]], keys: Dict[String, Bool]) -> Bool {
    headers['Content-Type'] in keys
}

fn opt-elements(xs: Array[String]) -> String | nil {
    let [first, ?second] = xs
    second
}

fn record-trie() -> Int {
    let record: _ = %{}
    let d = record
    for part in ['a', 'b'] {
        d = d[part] ?? (d[part] = %{})
    }
    d['leaf'] = 1
    #record
}

fn merge(a: Dict[String, Int | nil], b: Dict[String, Int | nil]) -> Dict[String, Int | nil] { a + b }

fn polling(sock: Int) -> Int {
    let fds: [Int | (Int, Int, String)] = [sock]
    fds.push((sock, POLLIN, 'tag'))
    #fds
}

print(seek('b'), count('c'), decode('a=1&a&b'), commit-later())
print(dispatch(handler, %{'id': 'xy'}), route-map(), member(%{'Content-Type': 'x'}, %{'x': true}))
print(opt-elements(['p']), record-trie(), merge(%{'k': 1}, %{'j': nil}), polling(0), wants-int(Box()))
